parameters.content:
## Follow-ups (with Nil's approval)
Daily: for up to 15 due leads (Stage Sent / Follow-up 1 / Follow-up 2, Next Follow-up Date reached, not on the Suppression tab, no reply in the Gmail thread):
- No draft yet, or Approved = Edit: the model writes the follow-up, "Check Follow-up" screens it (buyers, money, quantities, hype), and the clean text goes to the Leads column "Follow-up Draft" with Approved = Pending. Blocked text goes to the Log tab and is retried next run.
- Approved = Yes: the draft is sent in the original Gmail thread, logged in HubSpot, the next follow-up is scheduled (+10 / +20 days from Sent At) and the draft column is cleared.
- Approved = No: draft cleared, no further follow-up scheduled.
- Approved = Pending: wait.
After the loop, Nil gets one summary (email, WhatsApp, Telegram). Separately closes leads still on Follow-up 3 with no reply for 7 days. Everything is appended to the Log tab.
